tom: Heads-up — magnet-13b-int4 bring-up shows a tiny but consistent token flip at ~2900 tokens when rotary_scale >= 2.2 and KV cache is warm.

anya: Minimal repro pls?

tom: command: `python tests/longctx_onboard.py --model magnet-13b-int4 --rope_scale 2.2 --context 4096 --use_kv_cache True --prompt tests/prompts/repeat-numeric.txt`

li: Cold run?

tom: Cold run reduces flips but doesn't eliminate them. Warm-cache reproduces every run.

debug-bot: KV fingerprint diffs begin at block 72, delta ~1e-4 in rotary multiply intermediates.

li: My hunch is fractional index rounding when computing rotary cos/sin at int4 precision. Try forcing fp16 rotary ops for int4 path.

anya: Also try re-encoding keys when writing to cache (pack/unpack) — if that reduces, it's an asymmetric quant packing issue.

eval-bot: Queued ablation: int4(base) vs int4+fp16-rotary vs int4+reencode on 4k longctx holdout (job 1762712345-ab).

tom: Uploaded small gist with prompt + compare script: https://gist.github.com/tom/rotary-kv-diff-1762712345

li: I'll run fp16-rotary patch and post logs. If fp16-rotary matches fp16 baseline, we ship a short-term mitigation.

anya: Assigning follow-ups: li -> fp16-rotary quick patch, tom -> stack of failing inputs, debug-bot -> full fingerprint export.
